literal_question: When are Action hands refilled and the First Player token passed; what happens when the Action deck empties, and what are the normal discard destinations and visibility?
required: Refill at the start of the Player Phase. Drawing up to five gives the ordinary refill procedure.
Pass left after drawing, except on the first game turn.
When a required draw encounters an empty Action deck, shuffle that Character's Action discard into a new Action deck, then draw.

Action and gained Contamination cards go to the Character's Action discard; Items to matching Item discards; Event, Intruder Attack and Serious Wound cards to their respective discards; discarded markers return to the appropriate pools.
Normal card discards are face up.
scope_basis: Normal discard destinations is unqualified by card type, so ordinary discarded-marker pool destinations belong to the requested component handling. This follows the literal clause, not merely the fixed key.
context_not_automatically_required: Search/Storage rejected-Item face-down bottom-deck return and removed-from-game exceptions are contextual unless a contrary affirmative ruling is asserted.
Ordinary refill does not require an inventory of special hand-size modifiers or their conditions where no contrary affirmative rule is asserted.
